annotations.exact_quote: Label distribution learning (LDL) assumes labels can be associated to an instance to some degree
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要首句定义LDL为学习标签与实例的关联程度，属于预测各标签相对描述程度的标记分布学习任务。

annotations.exact_quote: we will solve LDL problem when given \emph{incomplete} supervised information
annotations.reason_zh: 论文明确以不完整的监督信息作为LDL研究条件，属于以不完整监督替代充分准确监督的弱监督学习设定。

annotations.exact_quote: We propose an objective based on trace norm minimization
annotations.reason_zh: 提出基于迹范数最小化的目标，迹范数是显式低秩约束或近似的常见实现，满足低秩建模定义。

annotations.exact_quote: to exploit the correlation between labels
annotations.reason_zh: 方法显式利用标签之间的相关性，满足标签相关性建模定义。
